wait_time: about three days for the account report; chat exports are instant
format: either a .zip report, or per-chat .txt with media

steps.title: Decide which of the two you want
steps.detail: They are completely different. The account report is metadata about you. Exporting a chat gives you the actual messages.

steps.title: For the account report: Settings, Account, Request account info
steps.detail: Available on the phone or on WhatsApp Web, but not on the Windows or Mac apps. It takes about three days.

steps.title: For your messages: open a chat
steps.detail: Tap the contact name, scroll down, then Export chat. Choose with or without media.

steps.title: Send it somewhere you can keep it
steps.detail: The export is handed to the share sheet rather than saved, so pick your email, a file app or cloud storage.

steps.title: Repeat for each conversation
steps.detail: There is no way to export every chat at once. This is the part people find out too late.

notes: The account report contains no messages at all. It is your phone number, profile, group memberships, settings and counts.
A chat export is one text file plus the media as separate files. iOS and Android name and format them differently.
A chat with Advanced Chat Privacy switched on cannot be exported at all.

faq.q: Does a WhatsApp data request include my messages?
faq.a: No. The account information report holds metadata: your number, profile, group memberships, settings and message counts, but not a single message. To get messages you export each conversation individually from within the app.

faq.q: How do I export all my WhatsApp chats at once?
faq.a: You cannot. Export chat works one conversation at a time and there is no bulk option.

faq.q: Why can I not export a particular WhatsApp chat?
faq.a: If Advanced Chat Privacy is switched on for that conversation, exporting is blocked entirely.
